description: Entirely invented community-museum checker fixture; all people, services, and outcomes are synthetic.

invariants.rule: Only the theme scheduler may activate the public color palette.
invariants.rationale: A preview editor renders candidate colors without changing the active theme in this fictional site.

except.reason: The fictional scheduler is the designated theme activation entrypoint.

invariants.known_gap: Literal patterns cannot prove that activation was scheduled or authorized.

invariants.rule: Exhibit descriptions use one of the built-in renderers.
invariants.rationale: The fictional site chooses local text rendering for its public descriptions.

checks.known_gap: Textual match on the manifest; a transitive dependency pulling the same package in would not be caught.
Reads the committed config file as text. A driver set only through a runtime environment variable is invisible.

invariants.known_gap: Committed configuration cannot expose a runtime override.

invariants.rule: Preview-phase migrations have a rollback body or an explicit irreversible marker.
invariants.rationale: The marker records a human exception; the checker cannot authenticate its truth.
invariants.known_gap: Brace-matched text extraction, not parsed. The escape_marker is trusted on presence only, not verified for truthfulness.

invariants.rule: Rendering a page preview must not flush the shared preview cache.
invariants.rationale: An administrator reset is a different method in the same fictional service.
invariants.known_gap: PHP lexical scanner reports unresolvable method boundaries instead of guessing.

invariants.rule: Fixture invariant demonstrating that two different classes in one file, sharing a method name, are ambiguous without a class param.
invariants.rationale: Exercises method_body_forbids' class-attribution: neither PrimaryProcessor::process nor SecondaryProcessor::process is a PHP error, but without a class param the checker cannot tell which is meant.
invariants.known_gap: By design: two distinct classes sharing a method name in one file cannot be resolved without a 'class' param. See multi-class-with-disambiguation for the resolved form.

invariants.rule: Same file as multi-class-no-disambiguation, disambiguated via 'class'.
invariants.rationale: Proves the 'class' param resolves the same file's ambiguity to exactly one method.

invariants.rule: Fixture invariant demonstrating the fail-safe when 'class' names a class that doesn't exist in the file.
invariants.rationale: A typo'd or renamed class name must be unresolvable, not silently clean -- a rule that names a nonexistent class looks configured and checks nothing, which is config drift, not a passing check.

invariants.rule: Fixture invariant proving ::class references, the masked word 'class' in comments/strings, and a function-nested class do not confuse attribution when disambiguated.
invariants.rationale: Exercises three PHP lexical shapes at once: ::class constants, incidental use of the word 'class' in prose, and a conditionally-declared nested class with its own same-named method.

invariants.rule: Fixture invariant demonstrating that two anonymous classes sharing a method name are permanently unresolvable.
invariants.rationale: Laravel migrations are anonymous classes. Two anonymous classes in one file defining the same method name can never be disambiguated by a 'class' param, since anonymous classes have no name -- this is a permanent limitation, not a configuration gap to close.
invariants.known_gap: Permanent: anonymous classes have no name, so a method-name collision between two of them cannot be resolved by any 'class' value.

invariants.rule: Synthetic clean-status case: a scoped pattern is absent.
invariants.rationale: Exercises the clean status path for the invariants[] report contract.

invariants.rule: Synthetic no-targets case: the optional jobs directory is absent.
invariants.rationale: Exercises the no_targets_matched status path — a stand-in for a typo'd scope glob or an exhausted convention.

invariants.rule: Synthetic phase-skipped case: active only when the site is public.
Fixture invariant demonstrating rollup: one check clean, one no_targets_matched, invariant reports the worse of the two.
invariants.rationale: Exercises the worst-status rollup across an invariant's checks.

invariants.rule: An unavailable optional thumbnail provider is handled.
invariants.rationale: The fictional gallery can show a placeholder image.
invariants.known_gap: A textual handler does not prove correct recovery.

exemptions.reason: Synthetic demo-only theme path demonstrating an active exemption.
Synthetic expired exemption used to exercise reporting.
Fixture demonstrating a registered exemption with no currently-matching findings.

knowledge.claim: In this invented site, display_slug is editable while exhibit_uuid is stable.
knowledge.rationale: A lexical check can surface candidate uses but cannot establish identifier intent.
knowledge.known_gap: Substring proximity can produce false positives.

knowledge.claim: The fictional editorial catalog owns public exhibit labels.
knowledge.rationale: A documented example decision, not an inferred fact about another system.

knowledge.claim: A gallery page and a physical gallery room are distinct concepts in this fictional site.
knowledge.rationale: A name collision can hide a mistaken assumption.

knowledge.claim: The optional image provider delay tolerance is unverified in this hypothetical site.
knowledge.rationale: An unverified assumption should not become a rule.

knowledge.claim: The fictional image refresh budget has not been chosen.
knowledge.rationale: Exercises an unconfirmed knowledge entry carrying a check.
